subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the slab-on-deck pour strip between Foundation Plan

messages.text: The slab-on-deck pour strip reinforcement shown in Foundation Plan S-101 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Structural Detail 3/S502. We need an urgent response on this; please treat it as time-sensitive. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour. Please respond by Thursday, ahead of Friday's pour. This sits right on the edge, timeline-wise; hard to say for certain how quickly this really needs to move.
Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Structural Detail 3/S502; Foundation Plan S-101 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- #6 dowels at 12" o.c. -- apply at every slab-on-deck pour strip on this level, not just the one called out in Foundation Plan S-101?
